title: Existence that Transcends the Heavenly Dao
next_chapter_hook: Ancient Great Being revealed: The twin children of destiny are the only possibility to break the deadlock, but the price is that one of them must be completely annihilated

text.content: The tremors in the core area of the ruins grew increasingly violent, as if some ancient beast of immense power was awakening from its slumber. Cracks spiderwebbed across the ground beneath Chen Ji's feet, and he could sense a force beyond comprehension tearing through the barriers of space. That was an existence far more terrifying than the Heavenly Dao's Eye — a true horror that towered above everything.

dialogue.content: You've come. Faster than I anticipated.

text.content: That voice did not come from any direction but reverberated directly within Chen Ji's Mental Sea, like an ancient temple bell, causing his seven apertures to bleed. The divine consciousness of the Jin Dan stage was like a flickering candle in the wind beneath that pressure,，随时都可能熄灭. Chen Ji knelt on one knee, barely maintaining consciousness with all his strength.

In the Void, a vague figure slowly materialized. It was not a complete human form, but a constantly shifting chaos, within which a massive eye could be seen slowly opening — the pressure of that single eye was ten thousand times more terrifying than any existence seen at the ruins' entrance.

dialogue.content: Ten thousand years of reincarnation, and finally you arrive — the inheritor of the Tianji Record. Or rather, the next sacrificial offering.

text.content: Chen Ji wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth, lifted his head, and stared directly at that mass of chaos. His voice was calm, so calm that he wanted to slap himself: "Sacrificial offering? What makes the senior say so? The junior merely stumbled upon an incomplete ancient text by chance. How could I possibly be called a sacrificial offering?"

dialogue.content: A low laugh echoed from within the chaos: "The future you witnessed in that fragment of the Tianji Record is merely the lowest level of the Heavenly Dao's chess game. And I am the Chess Player standing at a much higher position."

text.content: Chen Ji's heart sank to the bottom of the abyss. He had always believed he was playing against the Heavenly Dao, never expecting that the Heavenly Dao's Eye was merely a piece in the hands of this being before him. Ten thousand years of scheming, layer upon layer, and he was but the outermost piece.

dialogue.content: Ten thousand years ago, someone attempted to break this chess game. Like you, he obtained the inheritance of the Tianji Record, yet he presumptuously sought to challenge the existence above the Heavenly Dao. In the end, he failed, was sealed here, and became part of this deadlock.

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. The failed challenger from ten thousand years ago was right before him? That being who once possessed the complete Tianji Record now existed only as a wisp of residual soul, sealed in the deepest part of these ruins.

dialogue.content: The more complete your Tianji Record becomes, the stronger the backlash of fate. When it is completely restored, that shall be the day you are devoured by the Heavenly Dao. This is an inescapable destiny, and it is also the karma I亲手 sowed back then.

text.content: Chen Ji slowly stood up, his legs trembling, but his gaze was exceptionally calm. He memorized it — the failed challenger from ten thousand years ago, the complete Tianji Record, the destiny of being devoured. He carved all of this into the deepest part of his Mental Sea.

choice.prompt: Facing this existence that transcends the Heavenly Dao, Chen Ji must make a choice:

choices.description: Even if there are beings above the Heavenly Dao, dash an egg against a rock to prove one's will
choices.visible_cost: Consume a large amount of Heavenly Fate Value
choices.visible_reward: Gain the favor of the ancient great being
choices.risk_hint: Extremely high risk, possible death on the spot
choices.process_label: 强行催动天机录，窥探更高层真相

text.content: Chen Ji violently bit through his tongue, spraying a mouthful of essence blood toward the Tianji Record Fragment floating in his Mental Sea. Golden light erupted from his Brow Center — that was the phenomenon of Heavenly Fate Value burning frantically.

choices.description: Not playing the game within its rules, seeking the possibility to break the chess game
choices.risk_hint: May be abandoned by two Supreme Beings at once
choices.process_label: 试探性提问，套取更多情报

text.content: Chen Ji suppressed the fear in his heart, a playful smile spreading across his face: "The senior says I am a sacrifice, but this junior wishes to know—does a sacrifice have the right to choose the altar?"

The giant eye in the chaos narrowed slightly, seemingly surprised by Chen Ji's reaction. For ten thousand years, countless challengers, upon learning the truth, had all despaired and collapsed. Yet this ant-like junior before them could actually still smile?

dialogue.content: Interesting. The first ant in ten thousand years to dare play tricks before me. Speak, what do you wish to ask?

text.content: Chen Ji calculated rapidly in his heart. He knew he had no chips to play, but he also knew that the reason this existence was willing to waste words with him rather than strike directly meant he still had value. Value meant room for negotiation.

dialogue.content: Your fate has been locked. You either become a chess piece, or you perish alongside this chess game. There is no third path. That person ten thousand years ago also asked the same question, and you should have seen his end.

text.content: The ancient great cultivator's remnant soul's pressure abruptly intensified, and Chen Ji felt his soul being strangled by an invisible hand, ready to collapse at any moment. Yet his gaze remained calm, even a trace of mockery curling at the corner of his lips.

choice.prompt: At the critical moment between life and death, how will Chen Ji choose:

choices.description: Directly expose the other's bluff, betting that it cannot kill you
choices.visible_cost: May completely enrage the other party
choices.process_label: 冷静分析对方话语中的漏洞

text.content: Chen Ji spoke with difficulty, his voice hoarse yet carrying a fierce edge: "If the senior truly could destroy this junior at will, why waste so much breath? You also need this junior... or rather, need the Tianji Record to accomplish something, correct?"

choices.description: First preserve your life, secretly seek a way to break the situation
choices.visible_cost: May be seen as a true chess piece

text.content: Chen Ji's knees slammed heavily to the ground. He lowered his head, his voice carrying perfectly crafted fear: "This junior is willing to listen to the senior's teachings." But in that moment of lowering his head, a cold glint flashed in his eyes.

The giant eye in the chaos gazed at Chen Ji. After a long silence, it let out a meaningful sigh. That sigh seemed to contain ten thousand years of solitude and exhaustion, causing the temperature in this ruins' core area to plummet.

dialogue.content: You are clever. Cleverer than the 8,723 inheritors before you. But clever people in such a deadly trap often die faster.

text.content: Chen Ji's heart lurched violently. 8,723 inheritors? This meant the Tianji Record had changed masters this many times in ten thousand years, and they had all failed? All become sacrifices?

dialogue.content: But this time... perhaps it will be different. A low voice came from the chaos: I can tell you a secret, a possibility to break this deadly trap. But the price is, you must endure something more terrifying than death.

text.content: Chen Ji raised his head, staring directly at that giant eye. His voice was calm, terrifyingly calm: "This junior awaits in reverent attention." He had prepared himself, no matter what price it was, he would hear it through. Because this might be his only chance.

dialogue.content: Twin Fates. The voice in the chaos rang like an ancient bell, echoing within Chen Ji's Mental Sea: When two souls bearing the same Heavenly Fate meet, their destinies shall intertwine.届时，天机录的预见将不再准确，而你也将获得打破死局的关键。

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. Twin Fates—a thought flickered through his mind, a memory he had deliberately sealed away. Chen Nian, his younger sister, the one taken by the Holy Sect years ago. Was she the so-called Twin Fates?

dialogue.content: 你明白了？很好。但这个 secret's cost is—当双生子命运交织之时，其中一人必须彻底消亡。不是陨落，不是封印，而是从时间、空间、命运本身中彻底抹去。这是打破死局的唯一方法。

text.content: Chen Ji felt as though his blood had frozen. Twin Fates—his sister Chen Nian. That person he swore to找回, that person he would exchange everything for. And now, someone told him the only way to save her was to personally erase her from the world?

choice.prompt: This truth is too cruel, Chen Ji must make the final choice:

choices.description: There must be another way, never at the cost of my sister
choices.visible_cost: May miss the chance to break the trap
choices.risk_hint: May be trapped in the deadly ground forever

text.content: Chen Ji猛地抬起头，眼中迸发出决绝的光芒："晚辈不信这是唯一的路。前辈输了，不代表晚辈也会输。" His voice trembled, but each word was like a nail driven home.

choices.description: First memorize this intelligence, secretly search for other possibilities
choices.visible_cost: May be seen through by the other party
choices.risk_hint: May be difficult to act under their surveillance

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, and when he opened them again after a moment, his eyes had recovered their usual calm: "晚辈明白了。这份因果，晚辈记下了。" His voice was flat, but waves churned in his heart.

The great eye in the chaos slowly closed, and the shifting figure also began to gradually dissipate. Before completely vanishing, that ancient voice sounded one last time: "去吧，蝼蚁。去寻找你的答案。但记住，你只有三次使用天机录的机会了……三次之后，命运的反噬将彻底吞噬你。"

The core area of the ruins returned to dead silence. Chen Ji knelt alone on the cold ground, his entire body soaked with cold sweat. Everything just now felt like a nightmare, but the densely packed new cracks on the Tianji Record Fragment in his Mental Sea all proved it was no illusion. The truth of ten thousand years ago, the secret of Twin Fates, the curse of three chances—all these would become his new chips.

He slowly stood up, wiping the blood from his face, a self-mocking curve appearing at the corner of his mouth. Waste? Sacrifice? Chess piece? He didn't care about any of these labels anymore. What mattered was he knew his situation, knew the truth behind everything. Now, he needed to grow stronger—not to become a higher-level chess piece, but to overturn the entire chessboard. Chen Nian...等着我。无论付出什么代价，哥哥一定会救你。

Just as Chen Ji was about to leave the core area, a familiar voice suddenly sounded behind him: "Chen Ji, what are you doing here?" It was Su Qingyao. That Inner Disciple Senior Fellow who had always been trying to investigate him was standing not far away, her eyes full of complicated emotions. And Chen Ji merely smiled faintly, that smile hiding ten thousand years of calculations and determination.
